question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        oi.seller_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        oi.product_id,
        p.product_category_name,
        oi.price,
        oi.freight_value
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
seller_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        product_category_name,
        seller_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) as distinct_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as distinct_orders,
        SUM(price - freight_value) as total_profit
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY product_category_name, seller_id
),
seller_5star AS (
    SELECT 
        od.product_category_name,
        od.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as five_star_count
    FROM delivered_orders od
    JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON od.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY od.product_category_name, od.seller_id
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.product_category_name,
        sc.seller_id,
        sc.distinct_customers,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.product_category_name ORDER BY sc.distinct_customers DESC) as rank_customers
    FROM seller_stats sc
),
top_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.product_category_name,
        sc.seller_id,
        sc.distinct_orders,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.product_category_name ORDER BY sc.distinct_orders DESC) as rank_orders
    FROM seller_stats sc
),
top_profit AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.product_category_name,
        sc.seller_id,
        sc.total_profit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.product_category_name ORDER BY sc.total_profit DESC) as rank_profit
    FROM seller_stats sc
),
top_5star AS (
    SELECT 
        s5.product_category_name,
        s5.seller_id,
        s5.five_star_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s5.product_category_name ORDER BY s5.five_star_count DESC) as rank_5star
    FROM seller_5star s5
),
pct_translated AS (
    SELECT 
        pct.product_category_name,
        pct.product_category_name_english as category
    FROM product_category_name_translation pct
)
SELECT 'distinct_customers' as achievement,
       category,
       tc.seller_id,
       tc.distinct_customers as metric_value
FROM top_customers tc
JOIN pct_translated pct ON tc.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE tc.rank_customers = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'distinct_orders' as achievement,
       category,
       to_ord.seller_id,
       to_ord.distinct_orders as metric_value
FROM top_orders to_ord
JOIN pct_translated pct ON to_ord.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE to_ord.rank_orders = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'profit' as achievement,
       category,
       tp.seller_id,
       tp.total_profit as metric_value
FROM top_profit tp
JOIN pct_translated pct ON tp.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE tp.rank_profit = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'five_star_ratings' as achievement,
       category,
       t5.seller_id,
       t5.five_star_count as metric_value
FROM top_5star t5
JOIN pct_translated pct ON t5.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE t5.rank_5star = 1
ORDER BY achievement, category
